_meta.notes: Priors are the share of closed defect tickets attributed to each root cause. Edge weights are P(symptom observed | root cause is active). Illustrative values: replace with your plant's ticket history.

unmodeled_cause.name: A cause not in the knowledge graph

burn_marks.name: Burn marks
aliases: black edges at end of fill

low_melt_temp.name: Melt temperature too low
low_melt_temp.remedy: Raise barrel and nozzle temperatures in 5-10 C steps, staying inside the resin datasheet window.

high_melt_temp.name: Melt temperature too high / residence too long
high_melt_temp.remedy: Lower barrel temperatures and check residence time (shot size should be 25-75% of barrel capacity).

insufficient_pack_pressure.name: Insufficient pack / hold pressure or time
insufficient_pack_pressure.remedy: Increase hold pressure and run a gate-freeze study to set hold time.

blocked_vents.name: Blocked or undersized mold vents
blocked_vents.remedy: Clean vents; confirm vent depth matches the resin (typically 0.01-0.03 mm); shorten the PM interval.

worn_parting_line.name: Worn or damaged parting line
worn_parting_line.remedy: Pull the mold for parting-line repair; blue-check shutoffs.

insufficient_clamp_force.name: Insufficient clamp tonnage
insufficient_clamp_force.remedy: Verify tonnage against projected area x resin factor; move to a larger press if needed.

wet_resin.name: Resin not dried / high moisture
wet_resin.remedy: Check dryer dew point (about -40 C) and drying time against the datasheet; quarantine parts since the last good moisture reading.

uneven_mold_cooling.name: Uneven mold cooling
uneven_mold_cooling.remedy: Balance coolant flow per circuit; descale lines; target under 3 C delta between mold halves.

contaminated_resin.name: Contaminated resin or regrind
contaminated_resin.remedy: Purge the barrel, inspect hopper and loader, and quarantine the current lot and regrind.

short_cooling_time.name: Cooling time too short
short_cooling_time.remedy: Extend cooling time until ejection temperature is below the resin's heat deflection temperature.

moisture_test.name: Moisture analysis of hopper resin
moisture_test.how: Run a moisture analyzer on a hopper sample and compare with the datasheet limit.

melt_probe_low.name: Melt temperature probe (air shot)
melt_probe_low.how: Take an air shot and probe the melt; positive if more than 10 C below setpoint window.

melt_probe_high.name: Melt temperature probe (air shot), high side
melt_probe_high.how: Take an air shot and probe the melt; positive if more than 10 C above setpoint window.

cavity_pressure_trace.name: Cavity pressure trace review
cavity_pressure_trace.how: Compare the cavity pressure curve against the validated reference; positive if the pack-phase peak is low or decays early.

vent_inspection.name: Vent inspection
vent_inspection.how: Inspect and gauge vents at end-of-fill locations; positive if blocked or below spec depth.

parting_line_blue_check.name: Parting-line bluing check
parting_line_blue_check.how: Apply bluing compound and close the mold under low pressure; positive if contact is incomplete.

clamp_tonnage_check.name: Clamp tonnage verification
clamp_tonnage_check.how: Read actual tonnage with a tie-bar strain gauge; positive if below projected area x resin factor.

mold_thermal_image.name: Mold surface thermal imaging
mold_thermal_image.how: Image both mold halves after steady state; positive if delta exceeds 5 C or there are hot spots.

ejection_temp_check.name: Part ejection temperature check
ejection_temp_check.how: IR-gun the part at ejection; positive if above the resin heat deflection temperature.

purge_inspection.name: Purge and hopper contamination screen
purge_inspection.how: Purge onto a clean sheet and inspect hopper and loader; positive if foreign or degraded material is found.
